thread:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: High streaming tail latency observed in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. P95 and P99 for streaming endpoints spiked; some clients reporting stalled SSE/WebSocket chunks. Auto-escalate after 2 min if not acknowledged. :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): acked. looking at dashboards now. which service?

raj (infra): appears to be proxy layer (edge-proxy) in front of runtime. spikes started ~5612348600. p95 -> 450ms -> 1.6s; p99 -> 1.2s -> 6.3s on streaming responses.

sam (runtime): seeing many long-lived connections with small writes; Nginx upstream write_timeouts + chunk buffering. logs show repeated "write() returned EAGAIN" on proxy worker.

lee (sre): any rate/traffic surge? I don't see traffic jump overall. but a subset of clients (chunked, keepalive) show retransmits. tcp_kill count up on some nodes.

jordan (pm): customer-impact: at least 3 enterprise customers reported UI freezes, one reported aborted sessions. Tina looped in. tina, any direct tickets?

tina (cust-success): support-bot pasted a customer complaint into #support: "Live transcript stops updating after ~15s, reconnect required." two customers on EU region. both on long-polling SSE fallback.

maria (oncall): running quick grep for proxy 504s and timeouts across the fleet.

sam (runtime): stack traces point to KV cache lookups blocking on disk for some hosts (cold cache thrash). but this looks proxy-level, not model runtime CPU.

raj (infra): investigating proxy host health. listing pods:
```
kubectl get pods -n edge | grep proxy | awk '{print $1" "$3" "$4}' | sed -n '1,20p'
# found 3 pods in CrashLoopBackOff and 2 pods in Running(1/2) in eu-west-1-a
```

maria (oncall): @raj can you scale a new replica set on eu-west-1? quick mitigation: scale proxies, enable immediate connection drain to healthy nodes.

raj (infra): scaling edges to +4 replicas now. command: `kubectl scale deploy/edge-proxy --replicas=12 -n edge`

support-bot: Automated: scaled edge-proxy -> desired=12 (eu-west-1).

lee (sre): I'm going to flip upstream buffer settings to reduce proxy-side chunk buffering (reduce proxy_send_timeout, proxy_buffer_size). prepping a tiny config patch.

sam (runtime): possible contributing factor: clients with small-write heartbeats cause continuous flushes; runtime writes tiny chunks, proxy tries to accumulate -> triggers frequent epoll wakeups. suggest enabling chunk coalescing in runtime for this release.

maria (oncall): setting temporary rate-limit on extremely long-lived streaming sessions to reduce burstiness. command: `redwoodctl routes update --id streaming --connection_limit 3000 --region eu-west-1` (dry-run then apply).

jordan (pm): are we able to enable graceful fallback to short-poll for affected customers while we fix? might reduce user-visible stalls.

tina (cust-success): I can offer impacted customers a temporary flag to force poll-based updates. will coordinate with support.

sam (runtime): I pushed a small runtime toggle to coalesce writes into 64KB windows for streaming responses. deploying to canary instances now.

maria (oncall): canary shows immediate improvement: p95 down from 1.6s -> 320ms on canary. p99 still high on some nodes.

raj (infra): new proxies became ready, but one older proxy node shows heavy GC and fd exhaustion. removing from LB and cordoning host.

lee (sre): rolled config to drop proxy_buffer_size from 16k -> 4k and proxy_send_timeout 60s -> 30s on eu-west edge. will monitor. note: shorter timeouts may surface client issues but reduce head-of-line blocking.

support-bot: Metrics: eu-west-1 streaming_p99_latency: 6.3s -> 2.1s (20m after mitigation). error_rate (streaming) decreased from 3.7% -> 0.9%.

maria (oncall): good. remaining item: investigate root cause: why proxies started buffering. any config changes recently?

raj (infra): checked deploy history: no config change in edge-proxy in past 48h. but there was a spike in a new customer feature this morning that opened many long-lived small-chunk streams from mobile clients. pattern: many conn with chunk size < 256B at 50ms intervals.

sam (runtime): runtime telemetry shows heavy small-chunk pattern; combined with a kernel-level Nagle + tcp_cork interactions on proxy -> causes inefficient syscalls and buffer fill -> then timeouts. on older proxy kernels this exacerbates.

lee (sre): hypothesis: client pattern + kernel/tuned sysctl combination -> observable stall. action items: 1) document and rate-limit small-chunk streams 2) tune tcp and epoll knobs on proxies 3) long-term: implement coalescing in the serving runtime by default.

jordan (pm): need a customer communications plan. Tina to draft and send to affected customers with apology and mitigation steps. mention temporary fallback.

tina (cust-success): drafting now. will include: root-cause being investigated, temporary fallbacks available, ETA for full fix 24-48h, and offer assistance to flip poll fallback.

maria (oncall): preparing handoff notes for next oncall in 4 hours. summary so far:
- Incident: streaming tail latency + stalls in eu-west-1 & us-east-1
- Impact: p95/99 exceeded SLOs, several customer sessions stalled; two enterprise customers reported UI freezes
- Mitigation applied: scaled proxies, removed unhealthy nodes, reduced proxy buffer/timeouts, enabled runtime write coalescing on canary, applied connection limits for region
- Current status: service partially recovered; p99 improved but not back to baseline everywhere
- Next steps: root-cause deep dive on client patterns + kernel tuning, full rollout of runtime coalescing, add guardrails to rate-limit tiny-chunk streams

maria (oncall): @lee @raj please own the kernel/sysctl tuning playbook. @sam continue runtime rollout. @tina coordinate customer comms. I'll handoff at 5612350800.

lee (sre): acknowledged. I'll create a follow-up runbook entry: "streaming-small-chunk-thrash" with sysctl checklist and detection alert (chunk-size histogram → >x spikes).

raj (infra): will open infra ticket to repro with synthetic small-chunk client and test across kernel versions.

sam (runtime): will schedule coalescing rollout across regions in waves. canary -> us-east -> eu-west. will monitor p99 and fd counts.

tina (cust-success): notif going out in 30m to affected customers. will post updates to this thread.

support-bot: Automated: incident status -> MONITORING. Next update scheduled in 30 minutes or on change.

maria (oncall): handoff note (to whoever picks this up): keep monitoring p99 and streaming error_rate; if p99 > 3s in region for >15m, escalate to SEV2 and page owners.

jordan (pm): thanks team. after RCA we'll look at product guidance for streaming patterns (recommended chunk sizes/heartbeat cadence).

lee (sre): logging an action item: add alert that correlates small-chunk frequency with proxy fd exhaustion; this should trigger earlier.

maria (oncall): handing off now. final status: mitigations effective, customers notified, root cause investigation in progress. 

support-bot: Thread closed for now — monitoring continues. If you reply, thread will reopen. :white_check_mark:
